summary: Thryv Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary Thryv, Inc. entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement on September 12, 2026 with Coldwater YP, LLC, an affiliate of Carolwood, L.P., to sell its US, Australia and New Zealand Yellow and White Pages print directories, related digital editions and Australia White Pages for a $142 million cash purchase price, subject to customary adjustments. The Purchase Agreement includes customary representations and warranties, representation and warranty insurance, and customary closing conditions and termination provisions. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Watch regulatory and closing conditions, purchase-price adjustments and the press release for strategic rationale and use of proceeds.
